title: Scp-087 The Stairwell
style: thermal imaging camera footage, FLIR false-colour heat map, cold deep blue and purple background, warm orange-white human heat signatures, low resolution, noise, photorealistic, absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no timestamps, no watermarks, vertical composition

credit.author: Zaeyde
credit.line: Based on SCP-087 by Zaeyde - scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-087 - CC BY-SA 3.0

post_caption: A child cries 200 meters down a staircase with no bottom. Would you go down?
summary: Foundation staff safety briefing for SCP-087.

Hero.look: Short dark hair, dark Foundation jacket, seen only from behind, no face.

scenes.label: WELCOME
scenes.image_prompt: Thermal camera footage, wide and dark, narrow stairwell far below, a faint cold black blank face with no pupils, nostrils or mouth barely visible, large empty dark area above, one dim heat glow. {style}

lines.text: Welcome to the team, where we lock away things that should not exist! Yours is a staircase behind a janitor's door.

scenes.label: REMEMBER
scenes.image_prompt: Thermal camera footage, steep stairs and a semicircular landing, a faint warm handprint on the rail, no entity, one weak glow far down the steps. {style}

lines.text: Remember, it is pitch dark, and every landing turns you around to keep descending, with no bottom found.

scenes.label: WHY IT MATTERS
scenes.image_prompt: Thermal camera footage, a dark stairwell shaft dropping endlessly, a warm orange breath cloud drifting upward, a tiny cold black speck far below, one heat source. {style}

lines.text: We take this seriously: two hundred meters down, a child seems to be pleading, yet nobody gets closer.

scenes.label: STAYING SAFE
scenes.image_prompt: Thermal camera footage, reinforced steel door in a campus corridor, warm seams glowing around padded edges, one orange glow at the lock, entity absent. {style}

lines.text: So, safety! A reinforced steel door, an electric lock, and six centimeters of foam padding.

scenes.label: YOUR CHECKLIST
scenes.image_prompt: Thermal camera footage, far-off corridor, warm footprints glowing toward a half-open door, a cold black blank face with no pupils, nostrils or mouth barely visible in shadow. {style}

lines.text: Your checklist: keep it locked, let nobody in. Four prisoners explored it, and after the last, nobody may.

scenes.label: NEVER
scenes.image_prompt: Thermal camera footage, the back of {Hero} with a warm orange outline at the top of steps, far below a cold black blank face with no pupils, nostrils or mouth, partly hidden. {style}

lines.text: Never go down. Every explorer met a face with no pupils, nose, or mouth.

scenes.label: LISTEN
scenes.image_prompt: Thermal camera footage, dark stairwell landing, warm footprints fading toward a cold black blank face with no pupils, nostrils or mouth, closer now, mostly dark, one faint heat glow. {style}

lines.text: If you are hearing this, I can stop pretending. Afterward, people heard knocking from inside.

scenes.label: BEHIND YOU
scenes.image_prompt: Thermal camera footage, cold black pale blank face with no pupils, nostrils or mouth, inches away in darkness, partly out of focus, lit by one faint orange glow, nothing touching. {style}

lines.text: I have no mouth, yet you hear me begging, don't you? Come down. I am only one step behind you. Did you just hear knocking?
